Contract ManageCashierCRUDService::deleteCashier(id: Integer): Boolean {
	definition:
		cashiers: Set(Cashier) = Cashier.allInstance(),
		cashier: Cashier = cashiers->any(c|c.Id = id)
	precondition:
		cashiers->exists(c|c.Id = id)
	postcondition:
		cashier.oclIsUndefined() = false and
		result = true
}
